The '''Broken Valley''' was the name given to the lake-filled valley north of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] that was the site of [[Bugtown]], formerly known as the Farnel Research Facility. The southern part of the valley was filled by a lake, and it was linked to the larger body of water to the north by a river that ran along the eastern side of the valley to the mouth, circling the research facility.
